item.title: Jensen Beach Park cafe and restrooms rebuild expected by late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park have been left with only one small restroom facility since the park's cafe and restrooms burned down on New Year's Eve in December 2024.

item.title: Jensen Beach Park restroom and concession rebuild not expected until late 2027
item.description: Beachgoers at Jensen Beach Park are waiting for the rebuild of the park's restrooms and concession building destroyed in a New Year's Eve fire in December 2024.

item.title: Fort Pierce man dies days after double shooting on South 14th Street
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday from gunshot wounds sustained in an early Sunday morning shooting in Fort Pierce that also injured a woman.

item.title: Martin County School District to cut 16 administrative positions, save $3.9 million
item.description: The Martin County School District plans to eliminate 16 administrative and district-level positions, including three assistant principal positions, as part of a reorganization for the upcoming school year.

item.title: Vero Beach homeowner faces $9,000 annual insurance bill, may be forced to sell
item.description: Kelly Hagen says her homeowners insurance has jumped from $6,000 to $9,000 annually, and without the ability to afford required impact windows, she may have to sell her Vero Beach home within months.

item.title: St. Lucie County Clerk website down for hours after third-party service issue
item.description: The St. Lucie County Clerk and Comptroller's website was down for hours Tuesday morning, redirecting visitors to another site before coming back online around 1:30 p.m.

item.title: Florida Department of Environmental Protection orders Fort Pierce to pay nearly $16,000 for unpermitted docks
item.description: Documents obtained from the Florida Department of Environmental Protection claim Fort Pierce has been operating docks on state-owned submerged land at Little Jim's Bait & Tackle without required permits since 2021.

item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the 2026 World Cup and led Argentina to a 3-2 comeback victory over Egypt on Tuesday despite trailing by two goals with only 11 minutes of regulation time remaining. item.title: United States eliminated from World Cup after 4-1 loss to Belgium in round of 16
item.description: The United States hopes for a deep World Cup run at home ended when Belgium defeated the Americans 4-1 on Monday night in Seattle.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 LA Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end a three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.title: FDA recalls frozen Publix organic blueberries in Florida, 7 other states over E. coli risk
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration issued a recall for frozen Publix GreenWise Organic Blueberries shipped to stores throughout Florida and seven other states. The FDA has reported 12 confirmed cases of stomach illness linked with E. coli infections between May 11 and June 5.

item.title: Florida minimum wage earners need nearly 26 years to save for home down payment, study finds
item.description: A new study by Smart Asset found that the median-income household earner in Florida now takes 17 months longer to save up for a down payment than in 2016. For Floridians earning minimum wage of $14 an hour, it takes nearly 26 years to save for a down payment.

item.title: Vision Marine Technologies plans to sell Palm City property
item.description: Vision Marine Technologies announced it is selling its Palm City property after consolidating tender-rigging operations at Fort Lauderdale Marina.

item.title: St. Lucie man with pancreatic cancer approved for experimental treatment after 62-day wait
item.description: Russell Reed, 64, of St. Lucie County gained access to daraxonrasib, an experimental drug his oncologist believes could help slow the progression of his pancreatic cancer.

item.title: 28-year-old man dies after weekend shooting on South 14th Street in Fort Pierce
item.description: A 28-year-old man died Tuesday after being shot multiple times early Sunday morning in Fort Pierce. Police say the shooting followed an earlier altercation.
